(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-39)
(quote) The application for registration shall include a portion allowing the applicant to indicate his or her United States citizenship status and to prove such citizenship status by providing an original or certified copy of his or her United States passport, United States birth certificate, consular report of birth abroad or certificate of naturalization.
